decisions.reason: ID Vault is a recently announced feature that strengthens the super-app ecosystem, costs little to keep as a module, and its value is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
The identity-bound wallet is only mentioned and overlaps with the payment framework, so it may be folded in, but it is cheap to keep while the prospects of payments in the platform resolve.

The NFC tag authenticator is a niche hardware-linked option with weak visibility and carries some risk of abandonment, but it fits the firm's core authentication expertise and keeping it costs little.
Its own dedicated page signals ongoing commitment, and payments are a central pillar of the super-app offering.
This flagship super-app platform embodies the firm's strategic direction and anchors the other options, so abandoning it is very unlikely.
Application shielding builds on the firm's long application-security expertise, has its own page, and is a sellable standalone product with low upkeep.
